Name: Marry Lantana - Custom Mermaid NPC
Author: ApryllForever
Description:
[size=6][center][color=#00ffff]﻿﻿Marry Lantana![/color][/center][/size]

This mod makes Lantana marryable, as well as adds her 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, and 14 heart events! (More events planned in the future!)

Also, a new cookable item and recipe are added: Coconut Cream Pie!

And... a sword! Mermaid's Kiss, a terrifyingly powerful blade, which you receive from her 14 Heart Event's Special Order! The Mermaid's Kiss can be upgraded in the forge to Mermaid's Eternal Kiss, using a radioactive bar! Power levels are slightly better than the Galaxy and Infinity Swords, to make there be a reason for the effort, but also not break the game.



[center][color=#00ffff][size=5]2 Heart Event[/size][/color]﻿[/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/35298/35298-1752679288-1461401904.jpg[/img]
2 Heart - Lantana Lagoon: Get to know Lantana and her love of animals, especially crayfish!  Introduction to her, learn a little about her, and delight in nature with her!
[center][/center][center][color=#00ffff][size=5]4 Heart Event[/size][/color][/center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/35298/35298-1752679529-1208272358.jpg[/img]
4 Heart - The Beach: unlocks swimming at the beach on Wednesday with Lantana! When she stands near the shore, talk to her if you want to swim! 

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/35298/35298-1752679635-641639190.jpg[/img]



[color=#00ffff][size=5][center]6 Heart Event[/center][/size][/color][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/35298/35298-1752679771-730981522.jpg[/img]
6 Heart - in the Cindersap Forest, after 7 PM, any season except Summer. More about Lantana's Backstory... 

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/35298/35298-1752679792-586209217.jpg[/img]
And then, dry off in front of Leah's fire, while Lantana opens up a little more!


[color=#00ffff][size=5][center]8 Heart Event[/center][/size][/color][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/35298/35298-1752680021-995387258.jpg[/img]
8 Heart - Lantana's Cave, after receiving a letter from her: Lantana asks you a special question! She sends you a Letter when you get 8 Hearts with her. After receiving the letter, go to her cave! :) She is trying to cast a spell here... it's not working... or is it?


[color=#00ffff][size=5][center]10 Heart Event[/center][/size][/color][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/35298/35298-1752680216-1756656338.jpg[/img]
10 Heart - The Beach, after 9:00 PM, after receiving a letter from her: Camp on the Beach with Lantana! She sends the Letter after you get 10 Hearts with her. 


[color=#00ffff][size=5][center]12 Heart Event[/center][/size][/color][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/35298/35298-1752680387-1663538199.jpg[/img]
12 Heart - Bus Stop: Learn how to make a Coconut Cream Pie with Lantana! You learn the recipe at the end of the event - a coconut, a sugar, a flour, and a milk!


[color=#00ffff][size=5][center]14 heart Event:[/center][/size][/color][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/35298/35298-1752680509-1519937015.jpg[/img]
14 Heart, part 1 - Caldera (the top of the volcano). Lantana gives you a special order to make a special sword! Requires 7 Iridium Bars, 73 Void Essences, and 13 Coconut Cream Pies. Place them in the Dropbox in her cave, found on the right of the cave, in her temple area.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/35298/35298-1752680741-126329976.jpg[/img]

14 Heart, Part 2 - Lantana's Cave: Receive the Mermaid's Kiss! 
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/35298/35298-1752680808-160457510.jpg[/img]

Forging the Mermaid's Eternal Kiss:

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/35298/35298-1752680890-948849963.jpg[/img]
All it takes is 1 Mermaids' Kiss Sword, 1 Radioactive Bar, and 10 Cinder Shards!


[color=#00ffff][center][size=5]In Brief:[/size][/center][/color]
2 Heart - Lantana Lagoon: Get to know Lantana and her love of animals, especially crayfish!  

4 Heart - The Beach: unlocks swimming at the beach on Wednesday with Lantana! When she stands near the shore, talk to her if you want to swim! 

6 Heart - in the Cindersap Forest, after 7 PM, any season except Summer. More about Lantana's Backstory

8 Heart - Lantana's Cave, after receiving a letter from her: Lantana asks you a special question! Letter sent at 8 Hearts.

10 Heart - The Beach, after 9:00 PM, after receiving a letter from her: Camp on the Beach with Lantana! Letter sent after 10 Hearts.

12 Heart - Bus Stop: Learn how to make a Coconut Cream Pie with Lantana!

14 Heart, part 1 - Caldera (the top of the volcano). Lantana gives you a special order to make a special sword!

14 Heart, Part 2 - Lantana's Cave: Receive the Mermaid's Kiss! 


Currently requires PolyamorySweet, because without it, I would have to make a ApryllCore mod, to share certain common needed functionalities, which I would prefer to spare all users from requiring (because it's rather a nuisance for users, I play a lot and I dislike having core mods cluttering my files, and I suspect a lot of other users do too. Spacecore is enough for me! :) ).
